ModuleCarried.name: Asynchronous Sensor
ModuleCarried.SpecificEffects: DMG Dealt increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>. When the target is more than <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles away, DMG Dealt additionally increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile further away, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

ModuleCarried.name: Annihilation Module
ModuleCarried.SpecificEffects:
Critical Hit chance increases by <color=#F74848>12%</color>. When actively attacking, Critical Hit chance additionally increases by <color=#F74848>3%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> target within skill range, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>12%</color>.
If Critical Hit chance exceeds <color=#F74848>50%</color>, Critical Hit DMG increases by <color=#F74848>1%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1%</color> of Critical Hit chance above the threshold, up to <color=#F74848>+15%</color>. If an active attack scores a Critical Hit on <color=#F74848>2</color> or more targets, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.
